metadata.subject: Dispute regarding Invoice #INV-2026-88 and lack of support
metadata.body_snippet:
Hello,

I noticed an unexpected charge of $1,450 on my latest monthly bill. I have attached the invoice for your reference. Furthermore, our team has reached out three times regarding the recurring API gateway timeout error and no one responded. This
metadata.reviewer_notes: Customer had billing dispute, expressed strong dissatisfaction with support response, and explicitly threatened subscription cancellation and demanded refund.
